_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot 2026-09-26 from Ecuador Fiscalía, Colombia Fiscalía, and named Spanish reporting. Ecuador Pampa convictions are for organized crime with drug-trafficking aims; Colombian profiles are charges, not convictions. Ecuador full-name matches are corroborated by unique first names and aliases but undisclosed second surnames are not guessed. Historical country associations describe case conduct, not current position. No operational route detail, person-person co-mention edges, or unlicensed images.
